004ffc69999d69ced40f9e91584079f314b20a7c.text: “刀”是一把刀：有刀柄，还有弯弯的刀刃。

005cbb0e77148a43784d926ce834ca7180b9f5c7.text: Seen from above as it soars upward, every part of the swallow stayed in place from oracle bone to seal script.

010131bffddf92c9e23c92b16d1b796922e34988.text: How did carvers tell a dog (犬) apart from a plump pig (豕)? By the dog’s slender waist and that perky curled-up tail!

01cc2f836be67e02de884d3e5216436294525191.text: How do you draw a whole forest without spending all afternoon drawing trees? Put two trees side by side!

023d51b426d5c754d20d450cdb808fc47ba9ceb0.text: The double-curved shape of 弓 is a reflex bow: when unstrung or drawn, its wooden limbs curve like a wave.

03a8bd8b84be90a58200775374c44e4201d0ce16.text: 到了楷书“鳥”，眼睛变成了头里的一点，底下的四个点则是它的尾羽和爪子。

0402f956901c9734c38a4fb6569be1022ba43820.text: In modern simplified writing, 雲 is written 云.

059e8114aebacc84570aac07fdeee92612bc0a83.text: 燕 is a swallow flying with its wings spread wide and its forked tail behind.

068485569b66d585f7528899992633f30d5d1c0d.text: ... while a gentle sheep with curly horns , 羊 , nibbles the fresh grass.

06cedde370b5720e893b3759e82139a693758c19.text: 木 is a tree: branches reaching up on top, roots spreading out below.

06f77057a8422a0fba94544d5f0396694ea3fae1.text: Put 女 (mother) and 子 (child) right next to each other and what word do they make? 好 , good and happy!

0729158c2dcd92a94b0369d9bec0bd14ba0ca900.text: 田角边，几竿修长的竹子随风摇曳，竹叶轻轻垂下，这就是“竹”。

0735239aa3bf17dcd02d009a26b07ac1c00454b7.text: 河岸边立着一棵树：树枝向上迎着阳光，树根向下紧紧抓住泥土。

0859c288d3b7b167c48466a84e0d714632eb328f.text: 大脑袋、张开的小手、裹着的襁褓：这就是孩子的“子”！

08cb81bcc7bde780c47e9cb8532e047d4aa92a84.text: 今天的“鹿”字，上半部来自鹿头和鹿角，底下的“比”则是它修长的四条腿！

09005b029ac546c54ee9d104a34b4ca8fc256733.text: 一笔横折钩做刀背，一笔长撇做刀刃，两笔就写出锋利的“刀”！

0a2e81bb3a9197a9ec67fe693b13a349fd1b42d1.text: Whenever you see 水 , or its three-drop sidekick , something wet and flowing is nearby!

0a8c299a1b3676413bb4a1b087185cd94ffbecca.text: 龟 has a head, a shell and feet. The oldest Chinese writing we have was carved on turtle shells and bones!

0aa99f3bba1d9b1402826703a95d58f4022ec188.text: Head at the top, tail at the bottom: the ancient 鱼 is a fish swimming upward. The four dots at the bottom of 魚 were once its tail!

0ad9ad7daefda866f15f3a67b2e5a3302fb7bf3c.text: ……一人一马朝着大河的方向，哒哒哒地飞奔而去！

0b4905d63b2fd2b5bc9351cd6dfbecd6b907171c.text: 小屋旁的院子里，一头圆肚子的小猪——“豕”，正哼哼唧唧地找橡子吃……

0d1d6c7ca48492d88f58a10e643aebcd81732c9b.text: Outside the rain patters on, while inside the rocky shelter everyone is dry and warm.

0da8fa867792e21bf1b093c629215db69126a471.text: 这就是树木的“木”——许许多多和植物、木材有关的字，都是由它搭出来的！

0dc41de640907a5e2d7ede724d5f8db812670d3d.text: 到了简化字“鱼”，底下的四点鱼尾又连成了一道稳稳的横画！

0ddaa38d7ee4152480b681cbe08b1efe90278a11.text: That is 木, tree and wood , the building block for hundreds of plant and forest characters!

0e2e4defe14124194ec0fbd4ae7232aa0bcee86b.text: Suddenly , ROAAAR! A fierce striped tiger , 虎 , creeps out of the forest toward the sheep!

0f063058decef4c5b825a81a956e554e114dbe72.text: 走来一位头顶束发插簪的大人：“夫”！

0f1478ae872e6636be31ddf73c2406617d56c2d6.text: Even today, the left curve of 月 sweeps down longer like the tip of a crescent moon!

0fbe79c3af70188f7bef2d64adc17274cd337a5d.text: 为了吓跑大老虎，拉满一张富有弹性的木弓——嘣！

101c94b46bb1db24252b1a6554a2c49b4937abae.text: Its earliest form showed a hand (又) holding a torch inside a room to search in the dark , and later came to mean an elder, 叟!

117753e6f332833f32389f689237f54a072f82fb.text: ... and hugs her little baby , 子 , who waves both tiny hands before drifting off to sleep. Good night!

11dd489915d5459d02a1358bcb526edbf1f8927a.text: In three thousand years, this character barely changed at all , an outer boundary with a cross of paths inside.

1200ae704ef813e7ed4c128e8aecb9a0c84f5dd2.text: Skimming low over the water flies a spring swallow: open beak in front, wide wings on left and right, and a scissor-like forked tail behind!

1280eefbddecb94fd11f9d46a0f6362127909ec6.text: Today 舟 still keeps its arched hull and cross-ribs , and sits on the left of boat words like 船 and 航!

1409ffef8b91f7b00171ddc9124c4672ac8fc120.text: 伞 has no oracle-bone or bronze carvings because folding umbrellas were invented later , yet the character itself looks just like an open umbrella!

141ce75f3fdd7e43d04f1adede7d180477d9f7e3.text: 还有一头顶着分叉大角的梅花鹿——“鹿”，也轻巧地走进山崖下躲雨啦！

15d0bc650c886181dcc8dfa32a744bac1b955852.text: Later, the two sprouts became the grass crown on top, and 早 (“early morning”) was added underneath to give its sound!

15e241425aee6f9a95e0f88d7272398d67afe3ee.text: Stepping lightly through the mist comes a graceful deer, crowned with a pair of branching antlers.

1647608722481cc6376bbeaf10fc62b1b95b6db7.text: 后来，两棵小芽变成了顶上的草字头，下面加上“早”字来提示它的读音！

167683a25cb20195ef1a1b9805fbd2159fec2c33.text: 一棵树是“木”，两棵树在一起，就成了树林的“林”！

17125b05f2515b5313ee89e931c923a436029c8f.text: 温暖的屋子里，一个胖娃娃裹在襁褓里，正开心地挥舞着两只小手。

175d5f93b05fd0d19d013aa6676056f3d7d60de9.text: Before paper was invented, people split bamboo into strips and tied them together into books , so they knew bamboo well!

17f44bb2e927c859649584ef75e5cd1b1cadb42e.text: In oracle bone and bronze scripts, the bird stands proudly with its crest raised and claws gripping tight.

17f8ecd8d7da91d8f66896b3765f2da11c5432c4.text: 月 is a crescent moon. People drew it as a crescent so nobody would mix it up with the round sun, 日.

18ad3857b7721768927b172c5400c29aa5b7a893.text: Why didn’t carvers draw a full round moon? Because a round circle already belonged to 日, the sun! Drawing a crescent made 月 unmistakable.

1976d0371f499ab99db88a96a38d6167c2e47360.text: 今天的“虎”字，顶上依然戴着威风的虎头冠，底下稳稳立着强壮的后腿！

1b3fd314df330c6ddae6283343ed3dc31f146f5c.text: Clip-clop, clip-clop! A spirited horse gallops across the plain, its thick mane and long tail streaming in the wind.

1b85d8e478d8668302a57d6e5aa8414e58deac85.text: 前面就是自家院子那扇对称的两扇木大门：“门”！

1bc3e2ad7c442990280d28d27baa879cc82f5c74.text: 他身手敏捷地一跃，跳上了马背……

1c85998c18bea6b176aaf13a8bfe6d90f453ff2f.text: 在现代简化字里，“門”写作“门”。

1cf990bf44f59766c3291e30597c3c8daf39ea8d.text: 三千年过去了，这个字几乎一点儿也没变——外面一圈田界，中间十字田埂。

1d732c153dfbd916273ad86984b25978a7003151.text: In today’s 雨, the top bar is the sky, the frame is the cloud, and the four dots inside are raindrops on the window!

1f47c60aa46df945fc94fcbd2d7de48755f90c24.text: Oracle bones were carved in narrow vertical columns , so the big elephant stood up on its hind legs, trunk pointing to the sky!

1f52241addaf2c4ac5ee0121459b4fbfffafd215.text: 河岸边，渔夫拿起一把弯弯的青铜小刀——“刀”，利落地割好麻绳。

1f75845fe4cc1a027a9a8822187717e99367cc67.text: The ancient 虎 is a tiger standing up, with a big open mouth, stripes and claws.

1f81a0f85a3a1a9940a575150bb92e37e38a48c1.text: 这扇装满阳光的小窗户就是“日”——既是太阳，也代表从早到晚的一整天！

1fc8791f62b7edb130842019b62c9c9dc8ba502e.text: 轰隆隆……淅淅沥沥！天空暗了下来，豆大的雨点落了下来：“雨”！

20d90d06592506b6553fd8d4851057fdfc5caacc.text: Find the beak, the eye, the wing and the tail! The ancient 鸟 is a bird standing sideways.

20ec784fe51d5a0bd7f98b0bb32ec6a0c885c484.text: 因为商朝占卜师就在龟壳上刻字，所以他们把“龜”画得格外仔细——背甲、肚子和爪子一应俱全！

21077794c8b046f0c8f362de06511f964ca30b1c.text: “竹”画的是两根竹枝，叶子垂了下来。

211bc7b83bc72df04648791ed7457954af86f906.text: Night falls, and a silver crescent moon hangs above the quiet courtyard.

21c6b5eddadb5b3c99fa0a73263287265b6ba25b.text: What a bright morning! The valley is wide awake, and our bird has found its new home.

238f9e1914d32adbb9e24fdca9dc201d6d2ccbca.text: Out from the cottage steps a brave old grandfather , 叟 , holding a curved wooden bow: 弓!

23bd2370874293fe6a45cb875e7203cbde99c2e1.text: Inside the warm house, a happy baby waves both little arms in the air while its legs are tucked snugly in a swaddling blanket.

24f01a3d5ddf1ea347051218a77f79d6950ec1d2.text: 古代的“叟”是屋子里一只举着火把的手——在找东西！后来它被借来表示“老人”，“找”的意思就交给了“搜”。

25b4f4161402bca7add5b2f31928228377094acc.text: ……轻轻抱着挥舞小手的宝宝——“子”，哄他进入甜甜的梦乡。晚安啦！

2609ae99f62b20f75a2db92cfe48a76c22a2cb4c.text: In modern simplified writing, 龜 is written 龟.

26232b0256605c88815fb345798a7732a9ec91e4.text: Even in today’s 燕, the top is the head, 北 on the sides are the two wings, and the four dots below are the tail!

26cf5df40a91a5deb9e91f19a909c8fe284cb422.text: 薄雾中轻轻走来一头梅花鹿，头顶立着一对漂亮的枝形鹿角。

26e3d77567f821b6acaf9219d5547a34814cd733.text: “門”画的是一扇有两块门板的大门。简化字“门”来自它快速连笔的写法。

2b09fa971e9defabf3cd81964279123e8bfd449a.text: Climb to the top of a hill and look down at the valley: farmers have divided the flat earth into neat square plots crossed by ditches and footpaths.

2b931fda50a70ff81988a171bb4fccf7c2ce9ce3.text: 一场温暖的春雨过后，嫩绿的小草芽钻出泥土，每根茎上都展开两片小叶。

2cae9eeddf44d51672f6917348812bb53ecf5ef7.text: 在三千年前的大盂鼎铭文上，“雨”是弯弯的天空下面落下一排排雨滴。

2d3da99437704ec8f7f70d4842815460c210597a.text: Grass was first drawn as little sprouts: 艸. Later, 早 was added underneath to hint at the sound.

2d521cde6b909937dc6cf41f78d91b3a1222e207.text: In brush writing, the middle current straightened into a hooked vertical spine, while the splashes joined into side strokes.

2d58193015362d4372f2d3a151112d674dad04bc.text: 到了楷书“馬”，马鬃变成了上面的横画，四只马蹄变成了底下的四个点。

2dd760097271717ea82b16d1cde8b140a30a94aa.text: The cool river water gives a drink to a young tree on the bank: 木.

2e4cb4ea1ef333fa8f33d946727ac5e8933307ea.text: To scare the tiger away, bend a flexible wooden bow and pull the bowstring taut: twang!

2f583f3ee44219d9e96ec218da5bed2970bb1752.text: 大雨哗哗下起来，啪！一把圆圆的雨伞撑开了，伞骨支着伞面，中间立着伞柄。

3089981db6376ae78cef8ee2bf9ddf7b0f7e9264.text: 三座山峰并排站着，就是“山”。中间那座最高！

31041cfd9bacecdfbe9c358845caae6cc14443ab.text: 在现代简化字里，“傘”写作“伞”。

321cd20a603d02ae9d574679634cb6a04da71537.text: In modern simplified writing, 門 is written 门.

3295b7e713ac93c6d5dbfaf238dd13aea4018659.text: Look at the branching antlers on top: that’s how you know it’s a deer!

3436c86f4be2d7fa4cd8c1452cce11af35bdbb70.text: 从青铜器一直到1400年前智永禅师写的《千字文》，“舍”始终顶着尖屋顶、立在方地基上。

34ab6b7ee2b565a80f7b6f8d1492d6e5947d5453.text: 上面是山崖厂字头，下面是方石头“口”，合起来就是石头的“石”！

371904357325a979169e6a0ad0d56e655c164b9d.text: Safe and sound! At the edge of the field stands a welcoming cottage with a peaked roof, a center post, and a raised floor.

3783e690a767699e2b3b9f514e7ce5b7de1374d3.text: In seal and regular script 魚, the scaly body became a checkered 田 shape, and the forked tail split into four little dots.

37a79d3245625a22b934fbe6e9e1b0801fdcf634.text: 弓 is a bow for shooting arrows. Some of the oldest versions even show the string.

385cb0f4964983e74864aeccf8f5f82b9d7f8a40.text: 看顶上分叉的鹿角，一看就知道是“鹿”！

3901da34dc2c46e84a52c574170c2c4a85938699.text: 守护山脚下的农家小屋

39571a2124172b131609c1ffd569973eb4678f36.text: Ahead stands the tall double-leaf wooden gate of home: 门!

3ac201b183667bdf5e58329f29cf230d24d5af12.text: 舟 is a small wooden boat. The lines across it are its planks.

3b05b8082c17259e2c5336ace49e34f24a41f473.text: 在现代简化字里，“鳥”写作“鸟”。

3caae3bfec55c7440705e4b147c0000f78b92fb8.text: 看大盂鼎铭文上的字形：一个张开双臂站立的大人（大），头顶正中横穿一根发簪！

3d6bbd933ab7a971ebd6216a1022bd8f7ed0c03d.text: “竹”字的左右两边各是一根垂下叶子的竹枝，并排站在一起就是一片翠竹。

3f61977947182e9254f0ae6fafa683e8d7c4178f.text: On the 3,000-year-old Da Yu ding cauldron, 雨 is an arched sky dome with vertical streaks of falling drops.

40513b05a8c39e8a12429771057ac1466b43c57b.text: 多么明朗的早晨！山谷彻底醒来了，小鸟也在树林里安下了家。

4149822853c69b6b7a2183f97537f7d64a4b535d.text: 到了篆书和楷书里，张开的双臂变成了下面一横，头顶的发簪则是上面那一横。

429abea85ccccc49d0e8661a6f6eecec1d441605.text: 穿过农田与竹林的奔跑

43010c52f85d00558883c48a9b6963698b717491.text: 捕到鱼啦！趁着天上的云还没变黑，快划船靠岸吧。

432a71b30c6cd1319c43be073eedeab465c760a2.text: 今天再看“象”字的最上面，你还能一眼认出大象弯弯的长鼻子！

43434e0ddc30a2c0dd4cba8c3c4d8efcf634c112.text: 中间弯弯的线是流动的河水，两边的点是溅起的水花。

4359022fd160444e9e9ca71e47c11139c826ce76.text: And in simplified 马, the four galloping hooves are swept together into one fast horizontal stroke!

43c8783cb2b65134ead2128c597a29282f098e21.text: The oldest 云 was simply two sky lines above a curling swirl of vapor. Later, 雨 (rain) was placed on top to make 雲.

442fd1abe6b044b2a295d9210251fe9fa12555d3.text: 田埂边上，嫩绿的小草芽铺满了草地，这就是“草”。

452d75fff90acb93f4eb97d9d81a3fb8b3149025.text: 它最初的意思是手里（又）举着火把在屋里找东西，后来专门用来称呼智慧的长辈——“叟”！

46575d03e3f4a3d00e445cf23e012dff02398174.text: 扑通！一条银亮的小鱼跃出水面——尖尖的鱼头朝上，带鳞的身子居中，分叉的鱼尾朝下。

47d2d30dfc40500c88703926145188989b271438.text: 今天的简化字“云”，又回到了三千年前那朵卷卷的古云朵！

485755ba3b3be56ccf68e076e4e68b4d68eb8c03.text: Carved upright on bone and cast in bronze, the tiger’s striped head became the famous “tiger crown”.

4912285211102e7a347720c04646c0d66f46b1e6.text: 快——啪地撑开一把圆雨伞，挡住漫天雨滴：“伞”！

4937d433b058313513925b1eb3ffa6464481c762.text: 在今天的“火”字里，中间的人字形是主火苗，左右两点就是跳动的火星！

4973be16e02133fb3c724602078f2337ecae8be1.text: 沙沙沙……细长的竹枝在微风里轻轻摇晃，尖尖的竹叶像绿羽毛一样垂下来。

4a02284461df7ab71c33aa97f3e27cd274f3b8d0.text: When the rain pours down, pop! Up goes a wide round canopy held up by ribs on a central handle.

4ab8b9c2322d848ded515c91bb42e0d99e4e254f.text: 汪、汪！守在大门口的是一只忠实的小狗，正欢快地摇着向上卷起的尾巴迎接主人！

4b0f7989a8e9e3e50d295abec8af7e3e35392ee3.text: In modern simplified writing, 網 is written 网.

4c04bde5f14dbed5b5882f3e30741cd34ebd7e9b.text: 在现代简化字里，“雲”写作“云”。

4eaba30f4500bafd26704be2f1e7bd64aa9f5b67.text: In the yard beside the cottage, a plump little pig , 豕 , sniffs for acorns...

4ee1156b5b052d5b76a022c6a99d37e765c17c51.text: 溪水对岸，一棵树挨着一棵树，长成了绿荫浓密的树林：“林”！

4f63c1ec6b2664d221655318fb81e857aa913545.text: 上面一横是天空，下面的点点是落下来的雨滴。

4f82ce5305ffabcf4195f6e20c604c1e92f7a87e.text: Out steps a grown man with a hairpin in his topknot: 夫!

4fb074baffcac5139e28c251329a82648b6cf6d7.text: After the rain clears, we reach a cozy thatched cottage at the foot of the hill: 舍.

4fb30be621418ced7b3524d317fc9a186f01a831.text: Round head, open arms, swaddled legs: that is 子, child!

4fef579d3befc3f9958cc0185ef0057c6674f118.text: 宽阔的大河上空，一朵卷曲的白云——“云”，慢悠悠地飘过蓝天。

502ce7ea8e2824d6b70bf1c9327a3eaff17fdc10.text: 看刻字的最顶上：那道弯弯的钩就是象鼻，下面是圆滚滚的身子和四条粗腿。

50af4e4bcede8ad538a07e26d2c289abf340d16a.text: 就算不画树叶，刻出来的样子也一目了然：中间是树干，上面两根分叉是树枝，下面两根分叉是树根。

50fb4576e9309b2398de5405289b56d00071f9d1.text: Woof, woof! Waiting right outside the gate is a loyal dog, barking happily with its tail curled high!

51a14c856e7c44311fc5ab62c3254322160ef76f.text: From bone to bronze to brush, the back of the knife stayed strong and angled, while the cutting edge swept down in a curve.

51c483b67eff563642aceb5337abfbd4db2d8f8f.text: A single tree stands by the riverbank: green branches reaching up for sunlight, and roots gripping the soil underground.

523317bb83be4eb97b45f8e6032f23dba5e5a18c.text: 看呀！东边的山脊后面，一轮红彤彤的太阳慢慢爬了上来：“日”！

525087c2cecdde85f80af57e69c555d914257813.text: “燕”是一只张开翅膀飞翔的燕子，后面还有分叉的尾巴。

54b31f0249095568a053881575baf035d80037f5.text: 嘣！老爷爷拉响弓弦，吓得大老虎掉头逃回了深山！

54f28e9b2f8048d8dcf774d12b09eef3e19678fa.text: 在6057号甲骨上，“田”被刻成分成四格的方框；在大盂鼎的青铜铭文上，也能找到它！

54fc70cad153323eac6962e72bb7b58d32fd0fc2.text: 拿小刀在坚硬的骨头上刻圆圈可不容易，于是刻字的人刻出边框，中间加上代表光芒的一笔。

5711951a710a1a470461473252b8b5cf6a02ccaf.text: Carving a round circle on hard bone with a knife was tricky, so carvers made an outline with a bright mark in the middle.

57d1cac229be2b80b9f5811309591528473f05fc.text: 不管是甲骨文、金文还是篆书，那对分叉的大鹿角始终高高立在鹿头顶上。

580bc6f1b6f0918a7ed9bc52cb28647470dcc1eb.text: With one nimble leap, he hops onto the horse’s back...

58e89916471dd1656d019ddcffdc1429a05e4727.text: 就算在今天的“燕”字里，顶上依然是燕头，两边的“北”是双翅，底下四点就是燕尾！

5a40eafd593bda097982d1b8dcb9d08d9fee593d.text: 在现代简化字里，“龜”写作“龟”。

5b14efcfe15db84af5dbadd23ac624d8d1de4ada.text: Twang! He snaps the bowstring, and the startled tiger bounds right back into the mountains!

5bd6014b75e5f097ccdf7ad1943ba1b117b6c9d8.text: 先写一个大人的“大”，头顶再加一根发簪，就是长大成人的“夫”！

5bfb70d91ca01a21e72e8035f16fb1a78ee4e748.text: 上面草字头表意，下面“化”字表音，合起来就是百花盛开的“花”！

5c7271ecdfc0e75d776b71614440a067615f13f6.text: 回家的小路旁，一朵朵鲜花在晚风里展开花瓣。

5ca1f77fba514a0827384dd4755bec0be7bd89f5.text: 要想画出一片树林，难道要画上一整天吗？聪明的人把两棵树并排画在一起！

5d3dfb1a36dc8a555f3a0b320cc4db4d0368ca72.text: The Giant with a Curling Trunk

5ec54b23b8b3d844e666059b51496f911cd1665c.text: “舍”是一座简单的小屋：上面是尖尖的屋顶，中间是柱子，下面是地基。

5f0c244742328bd7573074ccd969d5428cf7b465.text: “女”画的是一位跪坐着、双手交叉放在身前的女子。

5fbc8e1c59932a7ba586bb3d34b7b95bf2e18bf2.text: 暖烘烘的石头后面爬出一只小乌龟：背着花纹硬壳，四条短腿慢吞吞，后面还有小尾巴。

5fc782652fe7514f3e765c2d860383ce887bb430.text: 跟大象一样，为了写进窄窄的竖行里，骏马也竖着站了起来！

6024623b59e4a9651d5c75f69f33977178993f4f.text: The Puppy with a Curled Tail

608c790ebb6673c1144fd80878fa5a37a1bec518.text: In regular script 鳥, the eye became a dot inside the head, and the four little strokes at the bottom show its tail feathers and claws.

609ced774915306fe49a56330085673dcfe9bddf.text: Rustle, rustle... Slender bamboo stalks bend in the breeze, their pointed leaves drooping down like little green feathers.

6121ecc152e03b5b0c04eebf95949e7936334135.text: Notice how the left tree tucks its right root in politely so the two trees don’t bump into each other!

6160ff15044751ae1ee600634b6af8daf0da441f.text: 突然——嗷呜！一只张着大嘴的斑斓猛虎——“虎”，从林子里扑向小羊！

61938cfd1107e0129184daaa420c805b470d5911.text: Across the stream, trees grow side by side into a shady green grove: 林!

61ac936a3a5ca91045a75b165c71092f4c1d8fda.text: Quick , pop open a round umbrella to keep the raindrops off our heads: 伞!

629804e1be121dfe81c61f52ed9429e78ab82b14.text: 得儿驾！一匹骏马在原野上飞奔，浓密的马鬃和长长的马尾在风中飞扬。

632e42bd8bfa046fd57926e77583be32493b2cbb.text: Three thousand years ago, wild elephants roamed the Yellow River valley! Their most famous feature was that long, curling trunk.

63a24babc1e7ade8f460e0af6bcb15210331586b.text: 最古老的“火”就像篝火上向上跳动的火苗。

643c5c99dc3b81abe89059a6918f0a2e3f0e3e27.text: 在甲骨文和金文里，小鸟昂着头冠，小爪子稳稳地抓着树枝。

6504ea0e100d89ee6b989e5996704b3a14c0e796.text: 豕 is a pig standing up, with a round belly and a short tail. Find 豕 inside 家 (home): a pig under a roof!

653163b89a3b0466ab9165c0a3550d27e3bb2962.text: ……还有一只长着弯弯羊角的小羊——“羊”，正低头吃着鲜嫩的青草。

6629a286f015f71afcacf1c25cdf4e782fae1b09.text: Today’s 虎 still wears that striped tiger-head crown on top, standing on two powerful hind legs below!

67d254e6cb2651ecb5330433bc8bd7e1b05054c8.text: 古代的“虎”是一只竖起来的老虎，张着大嘴，身上有花纹，还有尖尖的爪子。

689ebe3b14bb3a2a08aa52fcd348e5686247e28d.text: Each half of 竹 is one bamboo stem with drooping leaves; side by side, they form a bamboo grove.

68a140305fa0013cffff3f5dc149bfc5d9c8ac14.text: Look out at the horizon: three rocky peaks stand shoulder to shoulder, with the tallest peak right in the middle.

6927e1c798071eb22f0fd50eea4d84a0be48315d.text: 独木不成林：一棵树是“木”，两棵树是“林”，三棵树叠在一起就是大森林的“森”！

692ac33f0f6869066fad5fd4701840f7426867ad.text: 两棵小草芽并排长在一起，就是“艸”——这是“草”最早的样子。

69455942caa18b4410279281607a52b577a1d118.text: 安全啦！田边立着一座温暖的小屋：上面是遮风挡雨的尖屋顶，中间是立柱，下面是地基。

69ac238e6aa2e3d9da0b8d324f5ab842934244b9.text: 乌云聚拢过来——淅淅沥沥！一串串雨点从天空中落下来。

6a705d7486cc93f4fe87dd688c2538d19ff98dc9.text: 刻字的人把两个“木”并排放在一起：两根树干、两丛枝丫，肩并肩长在同一片土地上。

6b0d2c6ced53996ea35a0382594618464c38c3aa.text: 听——哗啦啦！山上融化的雪水顺着山谷蜿蜒流下，两边溅起晶莹的水花。

6bfa0b5612cde1a7d491d77635eb092800a46126.text: That bright sky-window is 日, the sun , and also a whole day from sunrise to sunset!

6d7ad34adc9d411578c3db1723af457da302015a.text: Write 大 for a big person, push a hairpin stroke through the top, and you have 夫 , a grown man!

6df9fdb26da0853a4ed93007dd570b90f30861f2.text: High above the river, soft white clouds drift and curl in the wind.

6e173f0c0b83a33bbd1032b49e34db219570c6c7.text: 嗖！一只剪刀尾巴的小燕子——“燕”，贴着水面轻快地掠过。

6f10690135a7691d8641ab42d55000dcdcdc124a.text: Roaaar! Out from the mountain brush creeps a fierce tiger , jaws wide open, sharp fangs gleaming, and bold stripes across its back!

6f8da9c7417e54d40d49a86df514f7d8eab74ca5.text: After a warm spring rain, tiny green shoots push their way up through the soil, two leaves unfurling on each stem.

6fb380e0e89028df823d85dbf42e59b958647743.text: 夜深了，一弯银亮的月牙挂在安静的小院上空。

6fd5f819d4acf68fed68564b1647ed960104bbc7.text: See the long trunk at the top? Long ago, wild elephants lived in China, so people knew them well.

70260b3fca4c15fa75a6c6dde6098886920446df.text: 繁体“龜”保留了繁复的背甲和爪子，简体“龟”则用几笔勾勒出龟头、龟壳和翘起的尾巴！

71563b13aa46ae8b3df645e4ba839468cfa8bb81.text: “伞”是一个“年轻”的字，没有甲骨文和金文。可它看起来还是像一把撑开的伞！

716863ac50bcbdd05abe57388f804bfd3c89310a.text: As centuries passed, the curling trunk stayed right at the top of 象, while the legs fanned out into sweeping strokes below.

718a2ae70c6726be5668451d221b67c9254c076b.text: 去河边之前，工匠拿起随身的青铜刀：上面是握手的刀柄，下面是弯弯的单面刀刃。

71b285371f468fe8642780a35e7bc33d463c9d9f.text: 在纸发明以前，古人把竹子劈成竹简、编成书册，所以天天都和竹子打交道！

72c5d3253c3f26cf7e34e8067d1556762e4e9f8b.text: 舍 is a simple hut: a pointed roof on top, a post in the middle and a base below.

72cce778f0796158c74edc0dd7dfc00b3566c2ab.text: ... and away they gallop toward the river, hooves drumming clip-clop, clip-clop!

73b54bbfdf5c3a4304b6148c4d4b324e18c00414.text: From bronze vessels to the monk Zhiyong’s 1,400-year-old calligraphy scroll, 舍 kept its pointed roof 人 on top and square room at the base.

741b3351b33f1c3a43e05e5b6e246d646ca2068a.text: Ancient writers first drew a blooming bush as 華. Later, they combined the plant crown (meaning) with 化 (sound) to create 花.

74719b67e0481f0543875dc17091b3eeb5dad696.text: 很久以前，“花”写作“華”，像一株开满花的植物。“花”是后来才造的字：上面是草字头，下面的“化”提示读音。

74811683f5c1021df1cbbd8b4d1deddd5ce38b8f.text: 而在简化字“马”里，奔跑的四只马蹄一笔连成了一道飞快的横画！

74869be6ef1849de79e44f4ce2f0a9ad611d4b98.text: 撑船离岸喽！一叶窄窄的小木船滑入水中，弯弯的船身中间横着几块木板。

74e94d3536d0c80c2276269822335c6b9d8dff2d.text: 在现代简化字里，“網”写作“网”。

74f125a219ddf588a87790f37886f9d642f2c6c8.text: On oracle bones and bronze pots, the three peaks were drawn like a crown of stone.

75c81c4becfb2d6156595d4e3851ba082d2de3fd.text: Under the dry cliff, dry twigs catch a spark , crackle, pop! , and bright flames leap upward.

75f1c20c9e3e019f86d9e0c6b101c263e392b125.text: 看前面：突出的山崖下立着大石头——“石”，正好是个避雨的山洞！

766033a7eb7ab33ea738328942f86367955ead31.text: Inside the warm lamplight, a mother , 女 , kneels beside the cradle...

79b83718b3ca297c9d74749f422bb46ee5e0e775.text: 因为甲骨文是一列一列竖着刻的，大象只好后腿站立、把长鼻子高高举向天空！

7a152b6228b87563e745e2557ed1c0e4ab78adc7.text: A lively ride past the fields

7a61ed18271550b0136e0b9cb8ffd1b8263693a7.text: Neigh! A spirited brown horse , 马 , wants to race across the grass!

7af53564dfab728edfd7c4a6f8550e18ec4de32b.text: 犬 is a dog standing up, with a thin body and its tail curled up.

7c9c5010c60aec8802f66813f4e662b7d8507b66.text: 往远处望去：三座山峰肩并着肩立在大地上，中间的主峰最高。

7cb66dd823157e1621c9a4150d65bc87b810b471.text: 在干燥的山崖下点燃枯枝——噼里啪啦！温暖的火苗窜了起来。

7f939d721f09e4edc0878ea232fd2db417035b52.text: 嘘……星空下的山谷还在熟睡。三座安静的山峰立在夜空下，这就是“山”。

7f984e2e64b37e272c3ce3c94dcbe81de10787e6.text: Woof, woof! Our loyal puppy , 犬 , trots out to the gate with its tail curled high!

7fccb6cb84a220c906f8035196fa36d9b98fcc54.text: Because Shang-dynasty diviners carved their questions onto turtle shells, they drew 龜 with loving detail , shell, claws, and all!

7fd76a038072b3d74fd09edeb2aeb5f6610d4e42.text: 傍晚时分，是谁在照看农家小院呢？是一位慈祥又勇敢的老爷爷：“叟”！

80752aa9160a544266244ebe9e00d9fc8b178624.text: 竹 shows two bamboo twigs with their leaves hanging down.

80b2948573ae193f8c2f28acc64282ca5aff346e.text: To catch fish in the river, you weave hemp cords into a crisscross mesh stretched between two poles.

82915a55a41e2bb29c25fec155338bd22efb18cd.text: 找一找鸟嘴、眼睛、翅膀和尾巴！古代的“鸟”是一只侧身站着的小鸟。

836d3d028572ed5f9953c5a6b88c1a955a290e70.text: Roosters crow! Up in the morning sky shines a warm, round ball of light.

83800553917e5cbd6b269cab7a4792e01891d8ce.text: “木”是一棵树：上面是伸向天空的树枝，下面是向四周伸展的树根。

83a5d7cc1ccddd290728f57f31b5723bad093809.text: In oracle bone, bronze, and seal scripts, you can see the baby’s round head on top, two outstretched arms in the middle, and wrapped legs below.

83cafac53de6fd7747385ff42cd280074650fdf1.text: Before heading to the river, a craftsman picks up his bronze knife: a sturdy handle on top and a curved single-edged blade below.

8512bee32abaa71594f96e66610d4c40447a6528.text: 竖着刻在甲骨和铜器上的老虎，那颗布满花纹的大脑袋，后来变成了“虎字头”。

86220e5cbb3e588625d9468d4f4e88bf10df0bf8.text: By the corner of the field, slender stalks of 竹 rustle their drooping leaves in the breeze.

86f1bcca944bc9d2fd76d0dfa0432dfa25b75d83.text: The line on top is the sky, and the dots below are raindrops falling down.

8711ffa9f656e7f917471ca9e005e004b291e967.text: 夫 is 大 (a grown-up) with a line through the hair: a hairpin! Grown-up men in ancient China pinned up their hair.

882d982fdaedf1b54734210247b4c58c059019d8.text: 夜幕轻轻降临小村庄，一弯银亮的月牙——“月”，升上了星空。

882e79a0a213b9dc9cb9f31162d881b3ceec9e50.text: Four little squares inside one big square: that is 田, field!

885b52e7c1040448241d3b645039778d603b4cc6.text: 最早的“云”上面是两横天空，下面是一团卷曲的云气。后来人们在顶上加上“雨”，写成了“雲”。

88612891e4790233fe025c5f75925e9c852a45ef.text: 摇篮旁边，妈妈端庄地跪坐在草席上，双手轻轻交叉在身前。

88beca5390e45f28b11bb618c893254b93d081ff.text: 渔夫用力一撒，绳结交错的渔网——“网”，稳稳地罩向水面！

895fe0a3dc017b25cf17f609f3b12e19ce99adbe.text: Out on the wide river, a curling white cloud , 云 , drifts lazily across the blue sky.

8aaa1805416070f17ac8edc0479735bc0d9cc8ae.text: “弓”那一道道优美的弯折，正是古代反曲弓的形状：弓身弯曲，充满力量。

8b5e2275c61805c0ab8b2ed19ef38deb2896a853.text: 古人怎么区分竖着刻的“犬”（狗）和“豕”（猪）呢？秘诀就在小狗瘦瘦的腰身，和那根高高卷起的尾巴！

8c0c343eec48f2c74d89f07417942f0c18404569.text: “羊”是从正面看的羊头，上面有两只弯弯的羊角。

8e099bd19ed6596fbaa441e635158e578e772f77.text: 上面人字屋顶，中间支柱，下面方屋：这就是供人歇息的“舍”！

8f1258275231e8fc83fcabbafe26e8b6b4adbe77.text: In 犬 today, the little dot in the top-right corner comes from the dog’s ear and curled tail! On the left of characters like 猫 and 狗, it becomes.

8f42f4c70bf987501616eb05761e8711e30a2780.text: 在甲骨文和金文里，两只大羊角在头顶向两边弯弯卷起，下面是向两边伸出的耳朵和窄窄的羊脸。

8f9d0166f85a537fdb8ff96a36226f0df26828fe.text: Look at the top of the carving: that hooked curve is the elephant’s trunk, above its heavy body and four legs.

8faae011f344a50eb7a8c83ff2770c76c71b4950.text: 他解开木板拼成的小船——“舟”，轻轻划向波光粼粼的河心。

8fe7170f957209d69c2dc180b871cb9d32323d4b.text: 从上往下看这只向上飞翔的燕子，从甲骨文到篆书，它的头、身、翅、尾全都一一对应。

900bd4ca9b74df9fff4427410aa105dfc4d72200.text: 吱呀——走到自家院子前啦！两扇高大的木门挂在左右的门柱上，正等着我们推开。

90b65c184c2866d4a31a92a3656bb4fe5a90ef50.text: 古代的“马”是一匹竖起来的马！为了写进窄窄的竖行，古人常把动物竖着写。繁体“馬”里还能看到马鬃和马腿。

90dd50b3306028dec5f3a3eabf120a853d4cf3b0.text: 門 is a picture of a gate with two doors. The simplified 门 comes from a quick, flowing way of writing it.

91afef7e4a61d24a7ee44ac483787bfb65e67e75.text: In modern simplified writing, 馬 is written 马.

91ba3ff8e96f38f74b68786aee587b371a6b03d5.text: Even without leaves, the carved shape is unmistakable: a trunk in the middle, two branches curving up, and two roots curving down.

91d7d3450cb4e6767372fc57ae41b97fb064201a.text: 在“豕”（猪）头顶盖上宝盖头，就是“家”！屋里有猪，就代表一家人丰衣足食。

9247446d4bfd8ba6eff5abc505f690674297f193.text: 网 is a fishing net with crossing strings. Later people wrote 網, and simplified Chinese went back to the ancient 网!

92932a04dd77a8181faee6ae7602d4e8d493c83e.text: 小草最早画成几棵小芽：艸。后来下面加了一个“早”，提示它的读音。

929758d05604c11f7d3bb066469d5d9425e7c2c7.text: 繁体“門”依然画着对称的两扇门板，简体“门”则吸收了草书连笔，三笔就勾出了门框！

94e5d1ac3d7e4017ef531d790fff197c808dbcd8.text: Listen , splash, gurgle! Melted snow tumbles down the valley in a winding stream, kicking up droplets on both sides.

955e4b9c56c16b7ec13e852d9cc9b241542a3476.text: 今天的“舟”依然保留着船身和横木，还常常用作“船”和“航”的偏旁！

957ae337b78a92113ec139c6dc782d783cf27616.text: 叽叽喳喳！一只小鸟侧身站在枝头，尖尖的嘴、圆圆的眼、收起的翅膀和翘起的尾羽全都看得清清楚楚。

9680ea533abdfd5926f1650100bba1f34c83d38a.text: 刀 is a knife: a handle and a curved blade.

9807cb8e8c220c85c029fa022ffa4c01e82f8741.text: In seal and regular scripts, the person’s arms became the lower horizontal stroke, and the hairpin became the top stroke.

98080277cbc634acbe5c35f59eb67e5e44f1623f.text: Chirp, chirp! A little songbird perches sideways so you can see its pointed beak, round eye, folded wing, and tail feathers.

989575e7d5c6e87d03ff4d7d3eb9994dc0d22b3c.text: Grass crown on top for plants, 化 underneath for the sound huā: that is 花, flower!

99557d91c45e1e93639bad839412066a435c94fd.text: 看曶鼎青铜拓片上的“門”：左右两根长长的门柱，中间两扇带方格的门板面对面合拢。

997d07e5ae1092b588a721824424007f5533a24e.text: Look at the bronze inscription on the Da Yu ding: a standing person (大) with one horizontal bar , the hairpin , right across the top!

9a4919986e865e555c5124ff7b6a34a6ef05b120.text: Shh... the mountain valley is still fast asleep under the stars. Three quiet peaks stand against the night sky: 山.

9a9ff17742261c59fcead27a611f4ecf721cddb8.text: 在甲骨文里，马是竖着站的；要奔跑起来，它就四蹄落地！

9af3d1340d5af80fa2c1dfabd8daea9d07a05c2a.text: 小屋里大步走出一位勇敢的老爷爷——“叟”，手里举着一张弯弯的木弓：“弓”！

9c208c9f3dc991daa243573531aa14750c23da9b.text: 小河上空，软绵绵的白云随着风儿轻轻打卷。

9cab87157fe595686a2f772c17ee56a20d222ba6.text: Push off from the shore! A narrow wooden boat glides onto the water, its curved hull held together by cross-planks.

9d254de6759ab5ed951e4dc2a34ed047d2019784.text: Warm sunlight melts the mountain snow, and a clear stream rushes down the valley: 水!

9d9a538834ff3c10f48b7fed7d451778ca4df688.text: 两根挂着竹叶的竹竿并排站，就是竹子的“竹”！

9da2aeb9b7a57da13e206855b643344d0c553b1a.text: 一只春燕贴着水面掠过：前头是张开的小嘴，左右是展开的翅膀，后面拖着剪刀似的分叉尾巴！

9ed52134c33354687c538fc2f811b87d0c58021e.text: “夫”是“大”（一个大人）头上加一横——那是发簪！古时候，男子长大后要把头发束起来，插上簪子。

9f6aa2c89bed9805dfb3502290f5b6d8aa1d614f.text: Three peaks side by side make 山. The middle one is the tallest!

9fd52cc56a161a5ee804b602d3a35beafba0591c.text: Keeping warm in a sudden storm

9ffff3619a7107c4a135521ca3de9e8fb2c3e905.text: Drawn upright on bone and bronze, the boat looks like a tiny ladder with curved ends , the bow at the top and stern at the bottom.

a02d7e8a1a8a7ff7ee256ae164ef39627f1f4963.text: 后来人们在旁边加上绞丝旁，写成了十四画的繁体“網”，表示用丝绳编织。

a058fcc1a3ee04ae3f16fd8f8081ac0117259892.text: In regular script 馬, the mane became three horizontal strokes, and the four hooves turned into four dots at the bottom.

a08905182f5fd397b77bf631f1b37880a7863fcb.text: From oracle bone to bamboo slips, 女 traces that poised kneeling posture and crossed sleeves.

a08f7cd0ad6b872df811d38ef1f10a2e6e05ea37.text: 三千年前，黄河流域还生活着野生大象！大象最醒目的标志，就是那根又长又弯的鼻子。

a0f9330078cb43454c2303ca139f4987f285d0ca.text: Stand two leafy bamboo stalks side by side and you get 竹, bamboo!

a18fc150d6133055e1e51c043eadb91f91eceb25.text: 嗷呜——！山林里钻出一只威风凛凛的大老虎——大嘴张开，露着尖牙，背上布满条纹！

a1a799d6cd5d7bfe3fc582aff1a56e4cbb27a2f3.text: 在现代简化字里，“魚”写作“鱼”。

a2440d537cbe4abb29374a741971d4ef80b34c56.text: Baa, baa! Looking straight at you over the fence is a gentle sheep, with two curling horns on top and a pointed nose below.

a36220a489458124586a785ccdc0e3c85ec26250.text: 后来毛笔代替了刻刀，圆圆的太阳就变成了方方正正的框，中间留着一横。

a3e6cf973e4ddfa54c9df8e8ab1e57d6fdeb4d07.text: “犬”是一只竖起来的狗，身子瘦瘦的，尾巴向上卷着。

a4d416b9b6a4a2988a857fcc680124d996b93af1.text: 下大雨了，快到突出的山崖下躲一躲！山崖底下，正躺着一块结实的大石头。

a6461c070e0357ab11ad6508acedf6f339ff4fee.text: 大口里面加十字，分成四块小方格，这就是农田的“田”！

a6f81270435c4cfd32647a262f55e33e74d586e4.text: Plop! A silver fish leaps straight up out of the river , pointed head at the top, scaly body in the middle, and forked tail at the bottom.

a73eb8af5d7e3140ccca2642d346b5673b49e037.text: 仔细看：左边那棵树礼貌地把右边的一捺收成了一点，这样两棵树就不会挤在一起啦！

a755946292718d522b558526a2d5b41fdd529596.text: Look! Behind the eastern ridge, a warm red sun begins to climb: 日!

a9b34396af7d1306eb4a971dbf480ea6c01b09e6.text: With a wide swing, the fisherman casts his woven net , 网 , right over the water!

aafe796c8d11256b0c3211a890c3e5bb9f69ecd6.text: “子”是一个大脑袋、挥着小手的婴儿，腿裹在襁褓里。

ab6d27b98d8b4d4bec927ce44dd3a0efb988053a.text: 哗啦！水波里跃起一条肥美的银鱼：“鱼”！

ac4cbc5a7e106c83aa64daea0d17337e5f13b171.text: 慢慢地，三座山峰简化成三根挺拔的竖画，稳稳地立在一条底线上。

ac6c03e402bfc683008353d5745e8a53d9d4d095.text: 头在上，尾巴在下：古代的“鱼”是一条往上游的鱼。繁体“魚”下面的四个点，原来是鱼尾巴！

ad6f76ee448f04791560c19e928b5d4e00b2a888.text: Rumble... Pitter-patter! The sky darkens and heavy raindrops begin to fall: 雨!

ae1ad77ed3d03fa617ecbdbed14b0c37eb124e14.text: 从甲骨、青铜一直到毛笔字，刀背始终厚实有力，刀刃则弯弯地向下延伸。

ae8160c31d494f8058697dd22fe98b59dfc6c8c6.text: Carvers placed one 木 next to another 木: two trunks, two canopies, sharing the same patch of earth.

af361df66bd8a39dd7bab5a89759aee058de801e.text: The wavy line in the middle is a flowing river, and the dots on each side are splashes of water.

b06a0ed182611d4c09d53f899b8330b7b5569447.text: 古人最早把满树繁花画成“華”。后来，人们用代表植物的草字头加上提示读音的“化”，造出了“花”字。

b071a2ae7e341feed496c2ef0e20612ccc11c2b8.text: In oracle bone and bronze scripts, the V-shaped horns curl down on each side above the ears and snout.

b159ffc689410e990ec129b580cfa0bb59ee0a2e.text: 在古代中国，男孩长大成人时要行“冠礼”：把长发束在头顶，庄重地插上一根发簪。

b1840cf7ef2d31a0dc26836ae5c6afe5a033f011.text: On oracle bone No. 6057, 田 is carved as a crisp rectangle divided into four plots , and on the Da Yu ding bronze, it appears again!

b2667baeeb81087c61dd5dc9ccb7a62d02b69fe2.text: 汪汪！忠实的小狗——“犬”，翘着卷尾巴跑到门口迎接啦！

b26876c04c9c32881abe1010b2df1e5067e20777.text: 为什么古人不把月亮画成圆圆的满月呢？因为圆圈已经给了太阳“日”！画成弯弯的月牙，一眼就能认出“月”。

b2e9c0ec24e778da4e0c1eb6ceb47b3591ce5df8.text: Beside the cradle sits the baby’s mother, kneeling gracefully on a woven mat with her hands folded gently in front.

b4fb36053491b747d009a65651a71a545c570c4c.text: 在甲骨文和金文里，上面拐弯的厂字头就是突出的山崖，下面的小块就是滚落的石头。

b523786752bee0b1d43a9e23ddbb9a605ecad8af.text: Long ago, flowers were written 華, a plant in full bloom. 花 came much later: (grass) on top and 化 to hint at the sound.

b62ee32dbfbe3e5b53b84e66c0dea185950c89cd.text: 子 is a baby with a big head and waving arms, its legs wrapped up in a blanket.

b79c7f0c1955868d8f4ee23a34f3eb754e155bdb.text: In 鹿 today, the top roof and grid come from its head and antlers, and 比 at the bottom comes from its slender legs!

b7c3fcbb1959baf2eccd0b4409efce61d0ff09db.text: 顶上是嫩绿的草芽，下面是清晨的“早”，合起来就是小草的“草”！

b7c61f7aada646f56c671a8ef1867e8fd25cacda.text: Thump, thump! Attracted by the sweet bamboo leaves, a friendly elephant , 象 , lumbers into the clearing.

b84ea49eed116a135464039f0780effb7f6ef6ec.text: 直到今天，“月”字左边的一竖撇依然弯弯地向下伸展，就像月牙尖尖的角！

b8565796a6dcd380592290e7e3c3170bc8785cb8.text: 女 shows a woman kneeling, with her arms crossed in front of her.

b8581dd11299a3db8bcbb721e2da30eec3fe2113.text: 暖融融的火光，吸引了一只背着硬壳的小乌龟——“龟”，慢吞吞地爬来烤火。

b86fbbab2d1371b42aadf9f0d2b5d40513890795.text: Put a roof over 豕 (pig) and you get 家 , home! Having a pig under your roof meant a well-fed family.

b9d381c93958349fc9023d39fdeace69b71f337e.text: In modern simplified writing, 魚 is written 鱼.

ba248c54133bbcb9586140c6f8613ed3d6d89834.text: To stay dry in the storm, duck under an overhanging rock cliff! Right at the foot of the cliff sits a solid boulder.

ba9b5d458080f2175accb32923be1130cfdc3bb8.text: One tree is 木, two trees make 林 (woods), and three trees stacked together make 森 (deep forest)!

bb13c4c70aa04a00d1cd88fac861bdf1381ba324.text: 咩——咩！篱笆后面有一只温顺的小羊正望着你：头顶一对弯弯的羊角，下面是尖尖的鼻子和嘴。

bb3ae528fe20387c8d92c000cb7dda71aac0215d.text: Pointed roof on top, pillar in the middle, room below: that is 舍, a house to rest in!

bbe3ede8ffab1c375b691cbcfa2a1abcc5997735.text: Who is keeping watch over the farmyard at dusk? A wise old grandfather: 叟!

bc0d4d831b70d6c97b7ff5a8a5a5ff0044c0bab7.text: “舟”是一条小木船，中间的横线是一块块木板。

bc966c2eca949cfdc99110e02f7418785b3a08a0.text: Under the dry cliff, we light dry twigs into a crackling campfire: 火!

bda862828bf975e258f2bf57cf5329ec1e69c8d5.text: Woken by the morning light, a little songbird , 鸟 , darts from the single tree to build its nest in the woods!

be5d460c2b4b19e88fb53c20c5d0c56f42bebe38.text: Splash! Up from the waves leaps a plump silver fish: 鱼!

be8c9c33a8f112be9c78868b9697043618f38861.text: Over time, each peak became a clean vertical stroke standing on one solid base.

bef4762729c0f998201f7f4ea9b5237849333d36.text: 而简化字直接回到了三千年前最初的模样：外框里面两个叉，就是渔网的“网”！

bf6c2a6e55651c5079a8f292683721719f105c8d.text: Along the border of the fields, tender green shoots of 草 carpet the meadow.

bfe12e494dfe03b1ca082b84211f8612e4bc1891.text: In today’s 火, the sweeping center strokes are the main flame, and the two side ticks are dancing sparks!

c1409c75eeb3c53d36548e98231f200a08cb2d19.text: The ancient 马 is a horse standing up on its tail! Writers turned animals sideways to fit them into narrow columns. You can still see the mane and legs in 馬.

c1f084ddbde27597bec4b8cbbf60c3bccca3339d.text: 中间弯弯曲曲的一道是湍急的主流，左右两边的小短线就是飞溅的水滴。

c23c95c3af1283d183a7f58748ea24d3cc355975.text: 到了毛笔字里，中间的水流拉直成挺拔的竖钩，两边的水花也连成了撇和捺。

c38041b3ebe2c7b111a1418618a0d24cef6fac25.text: 今天“犬”字右上角的那一点，就来自小狗的耳朵与卷尾巴！当它做偏旁时，就变成了反犬旁。

c3bfbf63febe1b50f398ff41dcb370a14aa11d65.text: “弓”是射箭用的弓，有些最古老的写法还画出了弓弦。

c43b0d57d31e7b5bd194e9f1b87205ab21c0ce5f.text: 在甲骨文、金文和篆书里，顶上是圆圆的小脑袋，中间一横是张开的双臂，下面是裹在一起的双腿。

c48977703bb6d82776cc4ac5d01178c64c4cf036.text: Cliff overhang on top, square boulder underneath: that is 石, stone!

c5142a55ad88626930fec2fc0e2b9f1df3e25c1c.text: “石”画的是山崖（厂）下面的一块石头（口）。

c5c09785cc14ac82b2649cf7d7c698d660e30c1b.text: 在甲骨和青铜器上，三座山峰被刻得像一顶石头王冠。

c65ebc4f5eef28055d3dd98996a9e1e7c52ec971.text: Creak... We reach the front courtyard! Two tall wooden door-leaves hang on side posts, ready to swing open.

c70c0e4cb2e4cec7d58a4237cbcca2d4035b36b8.text: 甘甜的河水滋润着岸边的一棵小树：“木”。

c745349770feec4c24d2f595f9d4b0db59ba02a8.text: 在甲骨文和金文里，竖起来的小猪一边鼓着圆滚滚的肚皮，另一边伸着小短腿。

c7a736f791de6ba98caffe258037827c31981ceb.text: Look ahead: an overhanging rock cliff with a boulder at its foot , 石 , makes a dry cave!

c855e0972ad5e3f8bfd8c8426aa8c54bf3eae154.text: The earliest 火 looked like a three-tongued flame, with sparks rising on the left and right.

c94553920fd203e0eac8a6018075c20c43626b20.text: Later, the upward branches flattened into a clean crossbar, while the roots swept out left and right.

c9d229e20669b05447f3d50518c8f52e20a4b079.text: In oracle bone and bronze scripts, the top hook is the rocky cliff overhang, and the block underneath is the stone.

ca1ffd94cbfc80bae2e147d1f104966d86fb3f8c.text: 温暖的阳光融化了山顶的积雪，清澈的溪水顺着山谷哗哗流淌：“水”！

ca3120ed77b5a9b23ec256430ee47b2fdab1f699.text: Look at the top of 象 today: you can still spot the elephant’s curling trunk!

caf05d30e7a20b03f6cd120b0e6fecab010d3ee1.text: Look at the Hu ding bronze rubbing: 門 has two tall side posts and two paneled doors facing each other.

cc0d50735bfb2fe0b97950fb1b9d653d4884f365.text: 在现代简化字里，“馬”写作“马”。

cc0ff8b737a0eb762cfac404908653834cd4450b.text: 伞 is a “young” character, so there are no oracle-bone or bronze versions. But it still looks like an open umbrella!

cc28a7c597baf9d624a0f1aa47f7dd3e01c1ae45.text: “田”是从天上往下看的农田，被小路分成一块一块的。

cdf86f31cdf269a85151d2b64d363cf597c97be6.text: When brushes replaced knives, the round sun squared off into a neat window with one horizontal bar inside.

ce7d888039af81df98c0b731ee8848615514143d.text: Stood upright in oracle bone and bronze scripts, the pig’s round belly curves out on one side while its legs kick out on the other.

cf65e12e9094232d0f90702fb9d1c905cbf5e1b8.text: With just three winding brush strokes, 弓 still looks like a bent wooden bow ready to launch an arrow!

cf8408ebd0a762efeac5ee009e21c864844724ec.text: “豕”是一头竖起来的猪，肚子圆圆，尾巴短短。“家”字里面就有“豕”——屋顶下养着猪！

cfce82bd84512e790a2e31cf9516df7a3481eea1.text: 在干燥的山崖下，我们拢起枯枝，点起噼啪作响的篝火：“火”！

d0c9a3dadfeae6fa8353fbc951c854e6a88f9f08.text: 看到“水”或者三点水，就知道一定和水流有关啦！

d0dde6183c7d12aae615d332d782dc9c2d2f8b7f.text: “龟”有头、有壳、有脚。我们发现的最古老的汉字，就刻在龟甲和兽骨上！

d23db9ff7cb42a5785e6259ac55d4be8966c22ed.text: “月”是一弯月牙。古人把月亮画成弯弯的月牙，这样就不会和圆圆的“日”弄混了。

d3227d34695a95ad504a13cf0b7cc5e97c8816ab.text: 不管是繁体的“鳥”还是简体的“鸟”，脑袋里那一点，依然是小鸟亮晶晶的眼睛！

d343d3ee9f4b76c53f9d1a3336ec6c80379d70a3.text: 在今天的“雨”字里，顶上一横是天空，方框是云层，里面的四个点就是落下的雨滴！

d43bf3ce36ae6e0ec95ab940ec22bc0c96e12b29.text: 只用弯弯曲曲的三笔，今天的“弓”看起来依然像一张蓄势待发的良弓！

d5836b7f6a1200cb3a0b851d9a1ddb1da7b68642.text: Swoosh! A fork-tailed swallow , 燕 , skims low over the water, chasing dragonflies.

d5bfea1d3c43968834fe999b7b485d54952997b4.text: 三根竖画连着底座，这就是高山的“山”！

d5e4e36b10a9878eb77506bb5b84d477f030aa43.text: Drawn by the cozy warmth, a little turtle , 龟 , pokes its head out beside the fire.

d61d2942aca83ac14394e9652913dce4b2790f08.text: Dark clouds gather and , pitter-patter! , rows of raindrops fall from the sky.

d832c48f925516ee3a6da53a7eca6fcab71a7959.text: Then simplified Chinese went right back to the original 3,000-year-old picture: an outer frame with two crossed meshes inside , 网!

d8e7cd1c20ea23b0cac1eaa7f92e213501490150.text: “云”像一朵卷卷的云。后来上面加了“雨”，写成“雲”，简化字又回到了古老的“云”！

da26641c6a633f638f1990fc7590ada0c5627b72.text: 爬到山顶往下看：农夫们用田埂和水渠，把平平整整的土地分成了一块块方格。

da423f1a0f4994ca94e83d95f4e429c8f8a66c48.text: That gives us 草: green sprouts on top, morning sun below!

dbc8f416e9863765709642dd1bb24071abbb93ed.text: 羊 is a sheep’s face seen from the front, with two curly horns on top.

dcec9d788f1e47f190af626b66008a687a2f6c80.text: Whether written 鳥 or simplified 鸟, that little dot in the head is still the bird’s bright eye!

dd59fb7dc7f786e25ad875bd5b62ed3a7bb72d1d.text: 后来，向上的树枝变成了一道平平的横画，下面的树根化作了舒展的撇和捺。

dd79ef04b48e67d72a523a8e3b60f281c2257db4.text: Today’s simplified 云 returned to that ancient curling cloud shape from three thousand years ago!

de3fe9c703f0bfae3ee5ded182b1110f9ce81bfa.text: The ancient 叟 showed a hand holding a torch inside a house: searching! Later it came to mean “old man”, and 搜 took over the job of “search”.

de474eb9b379dd0d2126a4406a4e94c12a0a2e5a.text: 要想在河里捕鱼，就要把麻绳编成交叉的网眼，张在两根木杆之间。

de89f502cf6ed301a804ffa4e1ca1f758ac2b7d2.text: Later scribes added the silk radical 糸 and wrote 網 , a very complex character with fourteen strokes!

df53cc83ad96c7be0fe7e4d3e72b34c55a00516f.text: 在古老的字形里，你能看到它大大的眼睛、脖子后一排马鬃、四条腿和长尾巴。

e1432aa41c058fec44128a6889f7ebfed93c814a.text: In the ancient carvings, you can spot its big eye, flowing mane along the back, four hooves, and sweeping tail.

e1a065a4c140218318d887169b61ceeb652fc404.text: In every single stage , oracle bone, bronze, and seal , those proud branching antlers sit right on top of the deer’s head.

e1ce71645ada8a0de399058476c84f94420b2a3e.text: 到了篆书和楷书“魚”，带鳞的鱼身变成了“田”字格，分叉的鱼尾变成了底下的四个点。

e2350125725c75cb4156b2315e8c1bfb27ed2cf2.text: Beside the garden path, fragrant night blossoms , 花 , sway in the moonlight.

e35cbf7447669b1464a771fa756b4b9cdf394fe0.text: Along the path home, bright blossoms open their petals to the evening breeze.

e37719cc4bdc42fe5cab65281f18cf83ecf726af.text: 石 shows a rock () at the foot of a cliff ().

e4309b5032de4e44db3783123b98c865e35d1854.text: Out from behind a warm rock pokes a little turtle: a domed shell patterned with plates, four stubby legs, and a pointed tail.

e59e97595346e0d90000b9809dc40b465dd707ec.text: The first 日 was a circle with a dot: the shining sun. Later the circle became a square, because squares are easier to carve and write.

e62800d31aa55d373e9e21be243f9f50d43ed0d4.text: And stepping softly out of the rain comes a gentle deer with branching antlers: 鹿!

e65f757aa44f2a72278016da49cb87a66d076ed1.text: Three upright strokes connected at the bottom: that is 山, mountain!

e76848779e4090bba3c2cc9dc4e8a81c609b7ed5.text: 看到顶上长长的鼻子了吗？很久以前，中国也有野生大象，所以古人很熟悉它们。

e7c190c1c48d1227f2152c30846922e69eebc4cf.text: In ancient China, when a boy grew up into a man, his family held a special ceremony: they tied his hair into a topknot and slid a pin through it.

e84d77f8c65c0d7eace98a097f96d8eadcb36e6d.text: 洞外雨声淅沥，山崖下火光融融，大家都暖洋洋的。

e8b902a11f1d1e92a34c7f7ee4d6c759b2d9a840.text: On the riverbank, a fisherman uses a curved bronze knife , 刀 , to trim his hemp rope.

e910815edc15bc9ee8d4941656bd05e563334ee9.text: 从甲骨文一直到秦代竹简，“女”字始终描绘着这样温婉跪坐、双手交叠的姿态。

e9d5f92948849081fe0e5443776b9c57c0ccc4c7.text: In modern simplified writing, 鳥 is written 鸟.

ea6d7bd6ac332d41d3124f13d05c5c335025a871.text: 咚、咚！闻到清香的竹叶味，一头温顺的大象——“象”，迈着大步走进了空地。

eb82af134146fc2b512fc0f57ece1943845fdcd4.text: Oink, oink! Around the farmyard trots a plump pig with a big snout, a round belly, four short legs, and a stubby tail.

ec0d44500bd9603dbaa8e34ffa9f92049bf21b0c.text: Follow the footpath out of the woods, and neat square farm plots open up before us: 田!

ec191c708ffb506624e5050aac807818b75af02a.text: 云 is a curl of cloud. Later, 雨 (rain) was added on top to make 雲, and simplified Chinese went back to the ancient 云!

ec1ac823fb5287df89223047e6699a53c4c0387f.text: 竖着刻在甲骨和铜器上时，小船像一架两头微翘的小梯子——船头朝上，船尾朝下。

ed556352aae69172b3b1a2af5f3a40cbb7b7eb83.text: In oracle bone writing, the horse stands upright. To run, it drops onto all four hooves!

ed78fb863af4531aba6977c056f6666703fdeddb.text: 最早的“日”是一个圆圈，中间有一个点，就像发光的太阳。后来圆圈变成了方框，因为方框更容易刻，也更容易写。

edfa2a7b5d03157b7fb21922a611f0b13057072a.text: 顺着小路走出树林，眼前豁然开朗，是一块块方方正正的农田：“田”！

ee46504b2d0d892d137a6aa51c18d309c68be78b.text: The oldest 火 looks like flames leaping up from a campfire.

eeadbea4f82a605c3a03603ba3f587f6c672e426.text: In modern simplified writing, 傘 is written 伞.

ef3426a1747808ba218fbe92e5ca29c28a0b615c.text: 雨过天晴，我们来到山脚下一座尖顶的小屋前：“舍”。

ef4069d832e00879af18c08fc3d5fcb8b95a1d5c.text: The center wave is the deep current, and the short ticks on left and right are the splashes.

eff66de5a15e999916d192f5a3c083a527346351.text: 公鸡喔喔叫！清晨的天空上，挂着一轮暖洋洋的圆太阳。

f087069a62f764b0447d5c4737660765b051ec16.text: Traditional 龜 still shows the full patterned shell and claws, while simplified 龟 keeps the head, shell, and curving tail!

f0ef9b03ad4e22ff1b0f989866a89faefe8eb819.text: “网”是一张绳子交叉的渔网。后来人们写成“網”，简化字又回到了古老的“网”！

f16ecec840976261f3dcdde840dac2ef9fde3015.text: 回家的小路旁，芬芳的花朵——“花”，在月光下轻轻摇曳。

f198d7c32e7a527090a7c7715de7d4f9bc589d40.text: 哼哼哼！院子里跑着一头胖乎乎的小猪，长鼻子、圆肚子、四条短腿，加上一根小短尾。

f2798471d7a6d9c581b62526aec2618b9e994c88.text: 今天的“羊”字顶上两点依然是羊角！古人觉得羊吉祥又美好，所以“美”和“善”字里都有“羊”！

f29df6d2be98392c6e05ebf61f9c6180ed8b7bb3.text: Just like the elephant, the horse was stood upright on its tail so it could fit into a vertical column of writing!

f395b46e561160218e36197284160a9e9602aa80.text: Two little sprouts side by side formed 艸 , the original character for grass and herbs.

f3a6ec0c7fe50aceaad6ac90390cdd7747d96faa.text: 晨光叫醒了一只小鸟——“鸟”，它扇动翅膀，从独木飞向热闹的树林筑巢啦！

f3addcebc1a652eb2de75941c9db0e6fbea69318.text: 因为折叠伞发明得比较晚，“伞”没有甲骨文和金文——可你看它的样子，活脱脱就是一把撑开的伞！

f3b5aa3fd14689e47d99b7bccd5abd5a00b8f05f.text: In simplified 鱼, those four tail-dots join into one smooth horizontal bar at the bottom!

f427df2fd16b345ad6d1a92a702528f5e68a3d63.text: A fishing trip on the river

f62caca295a33ba19f4ac967822813faf4466d2c.text: Evening settles softly over the village, and a silver crescent moon , 月 , rises in the starry sky.

f710209c7c2067476851ba95e2f09e108a187e62.text: He unties his wooden boat , 舟 , and glides out onto the sparkling river.

f7223a093fafb1345a610ccb1cc71c9666a799f9.text: 咴咴——！一匹神气活现的骏马——“马”，想在草地上赛跑啦！

f76b8625953d808e063e6ce529b702249aeaabe8.text: 温暖的灯光下，温柔的妈妈——“女”，端庄地坐在摇篮旁……

f795dc17f2f98d9de99c8374de431c60f484121a.text: 几千年过去，“象”字最顶上依然保留着弯弯的象鼻，下面的象腿则化作了舒展的笔画。

f7e11559892483809e58bbdd6d67d033254411dd.text: 把妈妈“女”和孩子“子”放在一起，会合成什么字呢？就是美好、幸福的“好”！

f888488888a66f72c0c748ecbad98ed64a91e9da.text: Dinner is caught! Time to row back to shore before those clouds turn dark.

f8bfb1f4b9a33b89ca43d26a323dcbfd4dcdad2a.text: 田 is a field seen from above, divided by little paths into neat plots.

fca49e05307d874c982ddbf0e489e3a369d1e2a7.text: Two brisk strokes , one hooked back, one sweeping blade , form 刀, knife!

fce395a3fd94b669a7aa7495bb40715146e4a886.text: In today’s 羊, the two top ticks are still the sheep’s horns! And because sheep were prized, 羊 sits inside 美 (beautiful) and 善 (kind)!

fd953ba00ae270551982a807af87e10924e0ee4f.text: One tree is 木. Put two trees together and you get 林, a little wood!

fdab1f202a9fbfd058abfb1844e4c5dcdcfe060a.text: Traditional 門 still shows both swinging doors, while simplified 门 traces the whole doorway in three quick strokes!

fdc15b662063c0b769bd837231446f279396ca03.text: 最早的“火”就像一团向上蹿的三簇火苗，左右两边还飘着火星。
